# Ripple Out the Bars

[Film](../README.md) › [Editing & Timeline](../README.md#editing--timeline) · `ripple-delete` `close-gap` `cleanup` `demo-footage`

A cleanup pass ripple-deletes a stray bars-and-tone clip and closes a one-second gap, pulling the rest of the cut together.

## About

The assembly arrived with two problems: two seconds of bars and tone left between the ocean and
the dunes, and a one-second hole before the city. A ripple delete removes the bars and moves
every later clip two seconds earlier, then `sequence.closeGap` at the hole does the same for the
remaining second. The result is three scenes butted end to end, 12 s long, and the kit's check
finds no gap. The thumbnail is the first cut point after cleanup, where the dunes now follow the
sunset.
